<summary>
Task: Multi-step Excel task on /root/output/rar_result.xlsx (copied from /root/data/test-rar.xlsx). Steps: (1) populate Gold price sheet from IMF commodity xlsx, compute log returns *100, 3-mo vol, 12-mo vol, fill Answer STEP 1 blanks. (2) Fill Value-based country gold reserves 2025 in Answer STEP 2 (rows 11-13), add Volume-only countries multiplied by 2025 Jan-Sep avg gold price, compute exposure. (3) Replicate to STEP 3, use INDEX/MATCH or XLOOKUP against Total Reserves for 2025; drop countries without data; compute RaR.

Progress so far:
- Turn 1: Created task plan.
- Turn 2-4: Confirmed template at /root/data/test-rar.xlsx; copied to /root/output/rar_result.xlsx. Found /skills/xlsx/recalc.py exists.
- Turn 5: Inspected workbook. Sheets: Answer, Gold price, Total Reserves, Value, Volume.
  - Answer sheet: labels only at B1..B24 with the described STEP 1/2/3 structure. Blanks to fill in column C (or nearby) for rows 3-6, 11-13, 20-24.
  - Gold price sheet has 430 rows; A2='1990M1' through A430='2025M9'. Headers in B1 (gold description), C1 monthly log return, D1 3-mo vol, E1 12-mo vol.
  - Total Reserves sheet (18x16): rows 1-9 metadata, rows 10-18 are years 2017-2025 in col A with dates in B, and countries in cols C..P. 2025 row (row 18) has data for: Armenia(C=5086.3), Belarus(D=14425.9), Georgia(E=6158.7), Kazakhstan(F=65727), Moldova(H=5999.34), Uzbekistan(I=66311.75), Czechia(J=175830.49), Latvia(K=6076.9), Lithuania(N=7082.7). Missing 2025: Kyrgyz(G), Serbia(L), Montenegro(M), Croatia(O discontinued), Poland(P).
  - Value sheet (18x18): 2025 row (row 18) has values for: Belarus(D=7471), Georgia(F=1002), Moldova(J=10.71), Ukraine(L=3877.64), Uzbekistan(M=55092.42), Czechia(N=10121.89), Latvia(O=921.28), Lithuania(Q=807.1). Countries WITH gold reserve VALUE 2025 = Belarus, Georgia, Moldova, Ukraine, Uzbekistan, Czechia, Latvia, Lithuania (8 countries).
  - Volume sheet (18x12): 2025 row has values for: Uzbekistan(F=12.55), Czechia(G=2.3), Slovakia(H=1.019), Latvia(I=0.21). Countries in Volume with 2025 data but NOT in Value's 2025 = Slovakia only (Uzbekistan/Czechia/Latvia are already in Value).
- Turn 6-9: Downloaded IMF commodity file from https://www.imf.org/-/media/files/research/commodityprices/monthly/external-data.xlsx to /tmp/imf_commodity.xlsx (619KB valid).
- Turn 10-13: File has one sheet 'External' with metadata rows 1-4, data starting row 5. Column 77 is PGOLD (Gold, US$ per troy ounce). Data spans 1980M1 (row 5) through 2026M8 (row 564). 1990M1 is at row 125. Latest 2025 monthly prices captured: 2025M1..2025M9 available; 2025M9 = 3666.52; also has 2026 values.
- Turn 14: Confirmed Answer sheet dims B1:K24, no merges.
- Turn 15: Populated Gold price sheet: filled col B with prices for periods 1990M1..2025M9 (matched to template rows 2-430). Wrote formulas:
  - C (row 3+): =LN(B{r}/B{r-1})*100
  - D (row 5+): =STDEV(C{r-2}:C{r})  ← 3-month rolling STDEV of 3 log returns
  - E (row 14+): =STDEV(C{r-11}:C{r}) ← 12-month rolling STDEV
  Saved. Last period = 2025M9 with price 3666.52.

Concerns/notes for next round:
- Need to verify D formula: 3-month volatility typically uses 3 log returns; STDEV of 3 values is minimal. Task says "monthly log, 3-month volatility and 12-month volatility" — using rolling STDEV of monthly log returns is standard interpretation. May need recalc.py to render formulas as values before subsequent steps read them.
- STEP 1 Answer fills needed (row 3-6): B3 Z-score (95% one-sided = 1.645), B4 latest 3-mo vol (D430), B5 3-mo annualized (=B4*SQRT(12)? or =B4*Z*something? Task says "for the 3-months annualized data, calculate it based on 3-month volatility"), B6 latest 12-mo vol (E430). Row 3 Z-score should be filled with 1.645. Not yet filled.
- STEP 2 country list to fill Answer rows 11-13: 8 Value countries + Slovakia from Volume (Slovakia volume 2025 = 1.019 troy oz millions, multiply by 2025 Jan-Sep avg gold price). Need to compute Jan-Sep avg from Gold price sheet (rows 422-430 approx for 2025M1..2025M9). Slovakia value = 1.019 * avg_price.
- STEP 3 requires linking to Total Reserves 2025 (row 18): countries available with 2025 data are Belarus, Georgia, Moldova(?), Uzbekistan, Czechia, Latvia, Lithuania (Armenia/Kazakhstan not in Value's 2025 list). Slovakia not in Total Reserves sheet either — would be dropped. Need INDEX/MATCH or XLOOKUP.
- None of Answer STEP 1/2/3 fill cells written yet; pending in later turns.
</summary>
